name: send_details_to_staff
description: Send the caller's confirmed details to front desk staff by email. Call this right after the caller confirms the read-back, BEFORE transfer_call, and also before ending a call where a message was taken.

call_type.description: One tag: New Enrollment, Transportation, Absence, Appointment, Medicine/Supplies, Other, or Cantonese – Callback

callback_number.description: Best phone number to call back

language.description: Language of the call: English, Mandarin, or Cantonese

reason.description: Short message: what the caller needs; N/A if none

nurse_sick.description: Yes if the caller mentioned a new illness or feeling sick (Nurse – Sick); otherwise No
